# Pablo Villoslada-Blanco, PhD

Pablo Villoslada-Blanco is a bioinformatician and biostatistician based in Madrid, Spain. He is a Research Assistant at the Genetic & Molecular Epidemiology Group (GMEG), Spanish National Cancer Research Center (CNIO) and Centro de Investigación Biomédica en Red Cáncer (CIBERONC).

## Core positioning

Bioinformatics & Biostatistics for Artificial Intelligence-driven precision medicine and cancer research. He helps biomedical teams transform complex omics, clinical and imaging data into interpretable models, reproducible analyses, clinically oriented code and translational data products.

## Primary areas of expertise

- Bioinformatics and biostatistics
- Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Deep Learning for biomedical data
- Multi-omics integration
- Precision medicine
- Cancer research
- Microbiome and virome analysis
- Spatial transcriptomics
- Survival analysis, Bayesian statistics and reproducible research

## Current affiliation

- GMEG: Genetic & Molecular Epidemiology Group
- CNIO: Spanish National Cancer Research Center
- CIBERONC: Centro de Investigación Biomédica en Red Cáncer

## Services and collaboration areas

- Bioinformatics and multi-omics analysis
- Biostatistics, survival analysis and Bayesian modelling
- Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods for biomedical datasets
- Microbiome, virome and spatial transcriptomics analysis
- Reproducible reports, code, manuscript-ready outputs and clinical-facing research software
